note: Debut-volume manga (no light novels) releasing in December 2026, plus January 2027 debuts with confirmed dates. Asobi Asobase Omnibus 1 from last month's list has moved to January 5 in Dark Horse's solicits. Several Yen Press December licenses have no confirmed day yet and are left out. Links go to Barnes & Noble.

items.why: The Jujutsu Kaisen sequel, set decades later with alien visitors, drawn by Yuji Iwasaki from Gege Akutami's story. A new series for Dan's shelf next to Jujutsu Kaisen, Chainsaw Man, and Kagurabachi.
Young people who failed at suicide are left on a remote island to fend for themselves. Bleak survival story for Dan's shelf with Gantz, Alice in Borderland, and Gigant.
A recurring dream sends Hina to 1907 Japan, where a man takes her for his fiancee. Period romance with a mystery hook for Cat, next to The Apothecary Diaries and Usotoki Rhetoric.
Two gyaru classmates fall for each other. GL for Cat, and the gal comedy Dan already reads in Gals Can't Be Kind to Otaku?! and Hokkaido Gals Are Super Adorable!
The only girl in a formerly all-boys class is sent to drag a truant back to school. Slice-of-life romance for Dan next to Blue Box and Please Go Home, Miss Akutsu!
An obsessive fan gains power over the electrical grid and uses it to push a mediocre idol's career. Dark showbiz story for Dan's shelf with [Oshi no Ko].

items.meta: Jan 5 · Dark Horse · mature detective comedy
items.why: Kenji Tsuruta's lazy Venetian detective must recover a stolen painting to inherit her grandfather's estate. Mature mystery that sits between Dan's seinen and Cat's mystery shelf.
A retired yakuza boss loses a turf war with a stray cat. Gag comedy for Dan next to Sho-Ha Shoten! and Komi Can't Communicate, with a cat angle for Cat's Cat Diary shelf.
A detective partners with a convicted witch to catch a killer called the Lifetaker. Case-of-the-week mystery for Cat, next to Usotoki Rhetoric.

items.t: Alma-chan Wants to Be a Family!, Vol. 1
items.meta: Dec 15 · Yen Press · sci-fi family comedy
items.why: Two scientists find their android insists they are her parents. Found-family comedy in the Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid space on Dan's shelf.

items.t: Mr. Vamp Is a Vampire, Vol. 1
items.why: An immortal history teacher thinks his disguise works, and the whole school plays along. Light comedy for Dan next to Komi Can't Communicate.

items.t: A Quirky Girl Is Inviting Me to Bed, Vol. 1
items.why: A student moves in with his older cousin in Tokyo and draws attention from several women. Fits Dan's mature comedy lane with We Started a Threesome!! and Breasts Are My Favorite Thing in the World!

items.t: Love Me to My Core, Vol. 1
items.why: A classmate written off as a jerk wants someone to see past his looks. Rated 18+ and shelved as BL, outside both main lanes.
